metadata.control_state: RAM controls 00809300; UVC shadows 0000800000009300 (neutral state in saved run records)
metadata.roi_method: Absolute 8-bit Y histograms over text-free rectangles; no per-trace normalization. Chart raster is used as reference, not a measured HDMI framebuffer.
metadata.bar_orientation: B1 vertical line pairs only; the saved native-size chart has no B2 horizontal-bar patch.
metadata.registers: FE84 values span 0x20–0x80 at the saved sampled values; FE84 is restored to 0x7A in each result record.
metadata.persistent_state: All source result records report EEPROM unchanged and firmware_written=false.
